newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-UEFA AND ENGLISH F.A. TO MEET OVER WORLD CUP ROW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UEFA AND ENGLISH F.A. TO MEET OVER WORLD CUP ROW.

text.p: Officials from UEFA and the English Football Association (F.A.) will meet on Friday to try to resolve the row triggered by UEFA's decision to back Germany's World Cup bid for 2006.
An F.A. spokesman said on Wednesday a venue and a time for the meeting had yet to be decided but it would probably be in London.
The English say European soccer body UEFA is wrong to interfere with the bidding process, which is strictly a matter for national soccer associations and soccer's world governing body FIFA.
The F.A. said it was astounded by UEFA's stance, revealed in a fax sent to F.A. headquarters in London last Friday.
UEFA responded by saying its support for Germany had been common knowledge for the last two years.
It said there must have been "a terrible lack of communication" within the F.A. for English officials not to have known about their stance.
